editorial.blurb: Maxwells Trading is a warm, inventive American spot where seasonal menus, thoughtful staff, and impeccable execution across small plates and pasta make every visit feel special.
editorial.insiderTip: The menu changes bi-monthly, so ask your server about seasonal standouts like the Korean Style Short Ribs with Melon—and save room for the Basque Butter Cake by ordering fewer dishes than you think you need.
signatureDishes: Korean Style Short Ribs with Melon
